Name: Simple Waystones
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Unlocking your network[/b]
Reach [b]Mining level 6[/b] and [b]Mines floor 120[/b], and Robin will send you a letter inviting you to check out her new building.
The farm Waystone costs [b]50,000g, 1,000 Stone, 100 Refined Quartz, and 5 Fire Quartz[/b], and takes two days to construct.

[b]Eight unique Waystones[/b]
Once your farm Waystone is complete, Robin sells eight themed stones: [b]Forest, Coast, Mountain, Desert, Island, Frost, Twilight, and Ember[/b].

Each costs [b]50,000g[/b] and can be purchased [b]once per save[/b], giving you nine destinations including your farm. Choose your favourites in any order—every theme works in any supported outdoor location.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Name your destinations[/b] and choose where your network takes you.[/*]
[*][b]Relocate smaller stones[/b] with an axe or pickaxe while keeping their names.[/*]
[*][b]Distinct artwork and coloured glows[/b] for each theme.[/*]
[*][b]Magical sounds and particles[/b], with a short charge before teleporting.[/*]
[*][b]A clean travel menu[/b] with stone icons and theme labels.[/*]
[*][b]Craftable Waystone Scrolls[/b] for travelling while away from a stone. One Scroll is consumed after successful travel.[/*]
[*][b]No teleport fees or energy costs.
[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/b]. Extract the
[code]SimpleWaystones[/code]folder into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder.

Multiplayer support is experimental. Every player needs the same mod version; the host handles construction and purchases.
